column3: Makes the Lord's seizure an active, severe enforcement behind the watchpoint.

Affirms the certainty of the Lord's punishment, supplying the watchpoint's consequence.
Sets the upheaval immediately before the surah's judgment scene.

Offers only a general pairing of creative power and knowledge.
Begins the local account of prior peoples on which the concluding watchpoint comments.

Adds return to the Lord as the accountability horizon.

Links the final report to knowledge from which God was never absent.
